name: Agent Membership Added
description: Ensures that agent Mark Smith (user_id 219) has been added to the same assignment group (group_id 36) of the case.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_added FROM user_group_member WHERE user_id = 219 AND group_id = 36;

name: Case Updated & Escalated to High
description: Confirms reassignment to the Tokyo agent, escalation fields, and priority/state for the specific case.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS case_modified FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 122 AND account_id = '5' AND product_id = '174' AND installed_product_id = '25' AND assigned_to = '219' AND priority = 'high' AND state = 'in_progress' AND escalation = 1 AND escalation_reason = 'customer_request';

name: Old Low-Priority SLAs Removed
description: Ensures previous low-priority SLA links (Response-Low sla_def_id = 4, Resolution-Low sla_def_id = 9) are removed from the case.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS low_slas_remaining FROM case_sla WHERE case_id = 122 AND sla_def_id IN (4, 9);

name: High Priority SLA Set Applied (Response + Resolution)
description: Ensures both High SLAs are active on the escalated case —  SLA Response - High (No Pause) (sla_def_id = 11),  SLA Resolution - High (sla_def_id = 7). Both must be in stage in_progress.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_sla_applied FROM case_sla WHERE case_id = 122 AND sla_def_id IN (7, 11) AND stage = 'in_progress';
